lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg16Ga4Si4 (reduced formula Mg4GaSi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 194), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga and Si centers each with 10 geometric neighbors, while Mg centers have 12 neighbors and one Mg orbit has a close-packed-like local arrangement. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Ga- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
